text:
sam: Canary looks unhealthy — 3/10 instances erroring, 95th latency jumped to 1.2s. Noticed around 03:42 UTC.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy v2026.03.20 -> started 03:40 UTC. Metrics: error_rate=4.6% (threshold 1.5%). Holding rollout.
alex: Yikes. Linking the backout/runbook we should follow: https://runbooks.internal/backouts/coldstart-rollback.md and the escape-hatch checklist.
maria: If we backout we must pin to v2026.03.19 to avoid partial rollout churn.
jordan: +1 pin. Also note release notes change set includes PR #4821 (model x optim).
sam: Can someone kick the smoke tests & confirm replication problem?
alex: Running smoke now against canary group A. Logs show KV cache misses.
ops-runbooks-bot: Runbook check: B/O-COLDSTART v1 required steps: 1) Pin version, 2) Disable autoscale burst, 3) Drain canary, 4) Rollback traffic, 5) Validate smoke, 6) Publish note.
maria: I'll approve pin. alex please post the exact pin command so deploy-bot picks it up.
alex: `/deploybot pin --version v2026.03.19 --reason "canary errors KV cache"`
deploy-bot: Pin requested by alex. Pending approval from @maria.
maria: approved.
deploy-bot: Pin applied: v2026.03.19. Noting in changelog: "rollback canary due to elevated errors".
sam: Initiating drain on canary nodes now per runbook step 3.
jordan: After drain, execute rollback traffic to stable pool. I can run that.
ops-runbooks-bot: Step 3 complete (drain). Step 4 in progress by jordan.
jordan: Rollback traffic executed, directing 100% back to v2026.03.19.
sam: Re-running quick smoke suite.
alex: Smoke PASS on 6/6 checks. Latency back to baseline. :white_check_mark:
sam: Good. Leaving note in release thread and tagging release manager. Follow-up: open a perf regression ticket for model team.
alex: Filed PERF-7329 with traces and flamegraphs.
deploy-bot: Canary hold cleared. Deployment marked rolled back. Recording: backout executed following B/O-COLDSTART runbook.
maria: Thanks all. Add a short blurb in the release notes: "Canary rollback executed due to KV cache regression; requeued for next window after fix."
ops-runbooks-bot: Runbook audit: steps 1-6 completed. Audit ID: RBA-2026-0319-01.
sam: Closing thread. If anything new pops up, reopen. :thumbsup:
